parts.text: Using the CURRENT Agents.md and CURRENT send-to-gemini.js, produce the complete replacement send-to-gemini.js implementing the new Bootstrap procedure and preserving all previously corrected behavior. The trigger envelope contains run_nonce and nextmessage. run_nonce must be validated as a path-safe identifier and must select an isolated run container at ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/runs/<run_nonce>/ containing state.json, messages.json, and store/store.json. Initialize those files when the run is new. Persist the same run_nonce in current_state.run_nonce, messages.json.run_nonce, and store/store.json.run_nonce and refuse mismatched association. Preserve the verbatim trigger user message as the initial run message. Every semantic-operator input/return exchange appended to that run's messages.json must also be persisted in that run's store/store.json with the same run_nonce, including execution, JSON repair, Step 3 internal-loop/transition repair, supervisory gate, and supervisory repair calls. A new run_nonce creates a separate procedure run; reusing a run_nonce resumes that same run without reading or mutating another run. Preserve current Step 3 evaluation-document behavior, Step 3 internal transition behavior, exact supervisory_gate.gate_result PASS/FAIL behavior, and missing-key repair behavior. Use exact Step 3 transition paths from Agents.md, including nested value fields where the schema defines them. Return the entire non-truncated replacement program, not a patch.
